about: Milestone 9 (v1.4) ear-test set: scripts\benchmark.bat builds one project per case in Documents\OrchSketch\Projects\Benchmark\Phase2c\. Default preset (Full epic), safe, seed 1, harmony B. Rate each project once, 1-5, in tests/ratings.csv (test = case id, alternative = B). X1-X3, X6 and X7 re-check your v1.3 notes; X4 and X5 are the new expression features. After the first round (tuning): re-rate only X2, X4, X6 and X7. New projects now start with Balance sections and High doubling: long notes only on, so every case has them unless it says otherwise.
